content: {"investigate": [{"tool": "sql", "query": "SELECT i.order_id, i.amount, i.vat, i.total, l.amount, l.vat, l.total FROM invoices i JOIN ledger l ON i.order_id = l.order_id WHERE l.vat != ROUND(l.amount * 0.15, 2) OR l.total != l.amount + l.vat LIMIT 10", "why": "Compare invoice values with ledger values to determine if the miscalculation originates in sync-job processing or if invoices themselves are incorrect"}]}
